goal_level_requirements.title: Manage User Authentication
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to register and login with role-based access (ADMIN/CUSTOMER).

goal_level_requirements.title: Manage Book Catalog
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow ADMIN to manage books and all users to browse/search books.

goal_level_requirements.title: Manage Shopping Cart
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow CUSTOMER to add/view books in their cart.

goal_level_requirements.title: Process Customer Orders
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow CUSTOMER to checkout cart and view order history.

interaction_level_requirements.description: The system shall validate login credentials and issue JWT token on success.
The system shall restrict ADMIN-only endpoints to users with ADMIN role.
The system shall support filtering books by category and bookType (physical/digital).
The system shall allow searching books by keyword with pagination.
The system shall associate cart with a specific CUSTOMER ID.
The system shall calculate total price from cart books during checkout.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall use JWT for stateless authentication and role-based authorization.
The system shall provide RESTful API endpoints with clear request/response formats.
The system shall use in-memory H2 database for easy testing and reset on restart.
